faq.title: Questions
faq.a1: Yes. The calculator is free forever, and you can create 3 quotes or invoices per month for free. Pro removes the limit and the watermark.
faq.q2: Which countries does it work for?
faq.a2: Margokit works anywhere: any currency, several tax rates, tax ID labels and legal mentions adapted to your country (France, Belgium, Morocco and more), documents in English or French.
faq.q3: Is it compliant with the French e-invoicing reform?
faq.a3: Margokit invoices include the new mandatory mentions (client SIREN, delivery address, nature of the operation, VAT on debits option). Factur-X export and sending through an approved platform are coming before the September 2027 obligation for small businesses. Margokit helps you invoice correctly but doesn't replace an accountant.
faq.a4: Yes. The monthly plan can be cancelled anytime from your Gumroad receipt; you keep Pro until the end of the paid month.
faq.q5: My card was declined. How can I pay?
faq.a5: Some cards aren't enabled for international online payments. Message us on WhatsApp: you can pay locally and receive an activation code.
faq.a6: Your data is stored in the EU, encrypted in transit, and only you can access your documents. You can export or delete your account at any time.
